body.purpose: Inherited base text and native controls.

label.purpose: Filters, field labels, and compact metadata.

shadows.name: surface
shadows.purpose: Root --shadow for form cards, discovery search, and theatre-directory cards.

shadows.name: poster-active
shadows.purpose: Solid offset under the active poster; hover/focus increases the offset to 14px.

shadows.name: comparison
shadows.purpose: Floating comparison toolbar and its menu.

motion.name: poster-transition
motion.purpose: Poster hover/focus lift; removed with reduced motion.

motion.name: grid-spring
motion.purpose: Default Motion position-layout transition; descriptive Motion parameters, not CSS syntax.

motion.name: grid-fade
motion.purpose: Optional grid-order fade from opacity 0.55 to 1.

motion.name: grid-presence
motion.purpose: Opacity and scale entry/exit; moving modes use scale 0.96. Off/reduced motion sets duration to zero.

components.name: Primary Submit
components.description: Form submit action; source has no dedicated hover appearance.
components.css: .ds-submit { margin-top: .25rem; padding: .6875rem .75rem; border: 0; border-radius: .625rem; background: var(--accent, #386d87); color: var(--on-dark, #fff); font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1.0062rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-submit:focus-visible { outline: .1875rem solid var(--focus, #386d87); outline-offset: .125rem; } .ds-submit:disabled { opacity: .6; cursor: progress; }

components.name: Add Action
components.css: .ds-add { border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-pill, 62.4375rem); padding: .3125rem .8125rem; background: var(--accent, #386d87); color: var(--on-dark, #fff); font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: .7906rem; font-weight: 800; cursor: pointer; } .ds-add:hover, .ds-add:focus-visible { background: var(--accent-wash, #e3f0f4); color: var(--accent, #386d87); } .ds-add:focus-visible { outline: .1875rem solid var(--focus, #386d87); outline-offset: .125rem; }

components.name: Filter Pill
components.description: Unselected and selected theatre filter states; static preview does not toggle application state.
components.css: .ds-filters { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .375rem; } .ds-filter { padding: .375rem .625rem; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #d4d4df); border-radius: var(--radius-pill, 62.4375rem); background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--text-soft, #555563); font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: .8625rem; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-filter:hover { border-color: var(--accent-soft, #bcd7e1); color: var(--accent, #386d87); } .ds-filter[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--accent-soft, #bcd7e1); background: var(--accent-wash, #e3f0f4); color: var(--accent, #386d87); } .ds-filter:focus-visible { outline: .1875rem solid var(--focus, #386d87); outline-offset: .125rem; } @media (max-width: 40rem) { .ds-filter { min-height: 2.75rem; padding-inline: .875rem; } }

components.name: Form Input
components.description: White, softly rounded field with the shared keyboard focus ring.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" aria-label="Theatre name" placeholder="Theatre name">
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: .625rem .75rem; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #d4d4df); border-radius: .625rem; background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--text, #26262d); font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: .1875rem solid var(--focus, #386d87); outline-offset: .125rem; }

components.name: Discovery Search
components.description: Elevated discovery input with container-level keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .75rem; padding: .875rem 1.125rem; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #d4d4df); border-radius: 1rem; background: var(--surface, #fff); box-shadow: var(--shadow, 0 .75rem 1.75rem rgba(43,43,73,.08)); } .ds-search span { color: var(--muted, #666674); } .ds-search input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--text, #26262d); font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1.0781rem; } .ds-search:focus-within { outline: .1875rem solid var(--focus, #386d87); outline-offset: .125rem; } .ds-search input:focus { outline: none; }

components.name: Application Menu
components.description: Circular trigger and anchored panel shown open as a static visual sample; menu behavior is supplied by React in the app.
components.html: TheatresWatchlist
components.css: .ds-nav { position: relative; width: 11rem; min-height: 9rem; display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-menu-button { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 2.375rem; height: 2.375rem; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #d4d4df); border-radius: var(--radius-pill, 62.4375rem); background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--text-soft, #555563); cursor: pointer; } .ds-menu-button:hover { border-color: var(--accent-soft, #bcd7e1); color: var(--accent, #386d87); } .ds-menu-panel { position: absolute; top: 2.875rem; right: 0; display: grid; min-width: 10rem; padding: .375rem; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #d4d4df); border-radius: .875rem; background: var(--surface, #fff); box-shadow: 0 .625rem 1.875rem rgba(0,0,0,.12); } .ds-menu-item { padding: .5625rem .75rem; border-radius: .5rem; color: var(--text-soft, #555563); font-size: .8625rem; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-menu-item:hover { background: var(--accent-wash, #e3f0f4); color: var(--accent, #386d87); } .ds-menu-button:focus-visible, .ds-menu-item:focus-visible { outline: .1875rem solid var(--focus, #386d87); outline-offset: .125rem; }

components.name: Theatre Directory Card
components.description: The directory's text-only card variant; poster-stack rows add overlapping movie artwork.
components.css: .ds-theatre { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; min-height: 6.25rem; padding: .75rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--border, #e5e5eb); border-radius: .875rem; background: var(--surface, #fff); box-shadow: var(--shadow, 0 .75rem 1.75rem rgba(43,43,73,.08)); color: var(--text, #26262d); font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-theatre-name { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 1.0781rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-theatre:hover { border-color: var(--accent-soft, #bcd7e1); } .ds-theatre:focus-visible { outline: .1875rem solid var(--focus, #386d87); outline-offset: .125rem; }

components.name: Movie Poster
components.description: Image-free preview of the actual fallback surface, lower readability overlay, and poster hover/focus lift. Real cards use movie artwork.
components.css: .ds-poster-button { display: block; width: 100%; max-width: 11rem; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; text-align: left; font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-poster { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; aspect-ratio: 2 / 3; overflow: hidden; border-radius: .625rem; background: #30354d; color: #d5d2ff; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(43,43,73,.12); transition: transform .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease; } .ds-poster-button:hover .ds-poster, .ds-poster-button:focus-visible .ds-poster { transform: translateY(-.25rem); box-shadow: 0 14px 28px rgba(43,43,73,.2); } .ds-poster-button:focus-visible { outline: .1875rem solid var(--focus, #386d87); outline-offset: .125rem; } .ds-poster-shade { position: absolute; inset: 35% 0 0; background: linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(20,20,32,.9)); } .ds-poster-label { position: absolute; right: .75rem; bottom: .6875rem; left: .75rem; color: var(--on-dark, #fff); } .ds-poster-label strong, .ds-poster-label small { display: block; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-poster-label strong { font-size: 1.0062rem; letter-spacing: -.03em; } .ds-poster-label small { margin-top: .1875rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,.72); font-size: .7188rem; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-poster { transition: none; } .ds-poster-button:hover .ds-poster, .ds-poster-button:focus-visible .ds-poster { transform: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Warm, sleek, and playful: a relaxed movie-club interface with confident typography, quiet controls, and expressive movie artwork. The surrounding UI stays refined and restrained so posters, movie titles, and the group's choices carry the personality.

The system is mostly flat, with soft shadows for raised controls and artwork. Warm paper grounds the light interface; compact white surfaces, Cinema Blue actions, and Charcoal Ink type provide structure without turning every content group into a decorated card.
keyCharacteristics: Artwork first, with quiet framing and compact controls.
Bold, tightly tracked headings over a practical sans-serif body.
Warm neutral surfaces with a restrained blue interaction palette.
Pill-shaped filters, softly rounded media, and responsive movie grids.

rules.name: The Artwork First Rule
rules.body: Let movie imagery supply visual variety. Use the blue palette to express interaction and selection rather than introduce unrelated decorative accents.

rules.name: The Role Before Scale Rule
rules.body: Reuse the nearest implemented text role. Do not normalize the existing fractional rem values or add a contrasting font as part of ordinary feature work.

rules.name: The Quiet Frame Rule
rules.body: Preserve the open poster grid. Do not wrap every movie and metadata row in another white, bordered, elevated card.

dos: **Do** reuse the root palette and contextual focus variable rather than hardcode new brand colors.
**Do** let movie artwork carry expression while surrounding controls remain compact and quiet.
**Do** reuse the existing text roles, rounded forms, container widths, and responsive grid behavior.
**Do** preserve distinct hover, focus, active, selected, watched, disabled, and loading states.
**Do** retain reduced-motion handling and safe-area clearance for fixed controls.
donts: **Don't** turn the unboxed poster grid into nested elevated cards.
**Don't** replace the light paper canvas or Helvetica family during an ordinary feature change.
**Don't** use semantic success/danger colors as unrelated decorative accents.
**Don't** suppress visible keyboard focus or apply text truncation where content needs to wrap.
**Don't** treat synthesized sidecar tonal ramps or static preview snippets as new production tokens or React behavior.
